phases.name: Add isFocused to AnyButton protocol and Button struct

steps.name: Expose isFocused on AnyButton protocol and Button<Content> struct
steps.description: Add var isFocused: Bool { get } to the AnyButton protocol in Sources/GameUI/LeafViews.swift. Add let isFocused: Bool stored property to Button<Content>. Add isFocused: Bool = false parameter to Button.init so all existing call sites remain source-compatible. Satisfy the AnyButton conformance by returning the stored property. Write Swift Testing tests in Tests/GameUITests/ButtonFocusStateTests.swift covering all five acceptance scenarios.
criteria: Given a Button constructed with isFocused: true, when the view tree is evaluated, then the Button carries isFocused == true
Given a Button constructed without isFocused, when the view tree is evaluated, then the Button carries isFocused == false
Given a Button constructed with isFocused: true, when the view tree is evaluated, then the action has not been invoked
Given a Button with isFocused: true, when the consumer explicitly invokes the action, then it fires exactly once
Given three Buttons where the second has isFocused: true, when the view tree is evaluated, then exactly one Button carries isFocused == true and it is the second one
steps.scenario_name: isFocused: true produces a focused node in the view tree
